name: pdf_create
description: Create PDF documents from complete Stash Markdown/text files, explicit images, or supplied text. Supports Unicode titles/body text using bundled offline fonts. For an uploaded .md guide, pass its original stash:// reference in files; the whole file is rendered directly with headings, lists, tables, code and clickable links, without a model summary or truncated chat preview. Use convert_file with source and target_format pdf for a straightforward Markdown/text file conversion. Actions: create for Stash files and mixed content; from_markdown for formatted Markdown supplied in text; from_text for literal plain text. Markdown-linked images are not fetched; supply image files explicitly to include them. Outputs save to Stash for download/printing. For reading, merging or splitting existing PDFs, use pdf_read instead.

action.description: create: original Stash files and mixed content; from_markdown: render Markdown in text; from_text: literal plain text.

space_id.description: Stash space ID containing source files and for output

files.description: Original Stash file IDs (with space_id) or stash:// references. .md/.markdown files render as formatted Markdown; .txt/.json remain plain text. Pass the original document here for complete conversion rather than copying a shortened chat preview.

text.description: Content to include. Use from_markdown for headings, lists, tables, code and links; from_text preserves literal plain text. Prefer files when converting an existing Stash document.
